sources.label: Morphe patches for streaming and news phone apps: skip ads, block tracking, and
sources.author: Mobile
patch_list: Stops Adobe, Amplitude, AppsFlyer, CleverTap, comScore, Kochava, Nielsen, and Firebase Analytics.
Lets Android darken the app while the phone is in dark mode. Android picks the colors, so some screens may look different from a designed dark theme.
Opens the app when a DNS blocker stops OneTrust, the app's privacy consent service. Without it, the app stays on its splash screen.
Hides the newsletter sign-up bars that ask for your email address in articles.
Removes the "Premium Content" subscription card and its "Latest Episodes" heading from show pages.
Stops the Google Play rating prompt.
Removes the banner, in-feed, and article ads, and skips the ad breaks in on-demand videos.
